population_definition.description: Member eligibility and relevant randomized/evaluable/analysis context; distinguish members from method.

population_size.description: Reported member count, not an assumed endpoint denominator or model sample size.

intervention.description: Drug/device/behavioral intervention or comparison actually assigned/received.

intervention_regimen.description: Dose, route, frequency, duration and common care needed to interpret comparison.

population_time_frame.description: Recruitment/treatment/follow-up periods defining population; each result has its own assessment time.

measure_name.description: Clinical quantity or criterion; a statistical summary is not a separate measure.

measure_definition.description: Instrument, response criterion, assessment basis and supported scale needed to distinguish measures.

population_id.description: Submitted population for this result; do not infer endpoint/model n.

assessment_time.description: Assessment point or change interval anchored to correct reference.

statistic_type.description: Reported principal statistic: mean, count, difference, HR, ES etc. Never infer unspecified ES formula.

statistical_method.description: Reported method, adjustment, missing-data handling and analysis version; state relevant missing details.

result_value.description: Source principal value or compact count/category summary; retain precision, inequalities, NR/NE. Do not calculate absent statistics.

result_unit.description: Source-supported unit/scale; do not assign score points to unspecified ES.

comparison.description: Actual submitted population IDs and explicit formula/direction; state when unreported. Null for ordinary arm summaries.

supplementary_statistics.description: Own CI (level/bounds), SD/SE, P, percentage and applicable denominator with meaning; never copy population totals to unreported endpoint/model n.

relationship.description: Direct source-supported membership relation. subset of is directional; disjoint from and overlaps with are symmetric.

population_b_id.description: Second population; parent for subset of.
